scope: LABOR COST ONLY (v1) — excludes materials, packaging, overhead

cost_model.formula: cost/unit = machine-hours-per-unit x operating-cost-per-hour; operating-cost-per-hour = (operators x wage) + machine overhead/hour

blend_cost.batches_note: Quantities are in POUNDS (LB blender ~2000 lb/batch; SB smaller). Cost = blend-hours x $33.68/hr all-in ACTIVE blending + $72.17/hr other. Does NOT yet include the 'rest' of blending cost (cleaning, raw-material handling/staging, setup). Base-level — NOT yet added to finished SKUs (needs a recipe map: which blend + pounds per finished unit).
